decisions.subject: tmpfs as the declared harness filesystem (ML-CAPA-364 fidelity change)
terms: baseline regression runs keep TMPDIR and the private basetemp on tmpfs; each run's configuration.json declares it
the fsync probe stays enabled and outside the basetemp
one persistent-media (ext4) reference run per increment is required before acceptance evidence is assembled; its expiries are triaged as observations, not as acceptance failures
tmpfs is a harness choice; it is never cited as a product durability property
decisions.rationale: Three consecutive tmpfs runs (e, f, h) show zero outer expiries while the ext4 host condition (90 percent full, shared write load) is external to the product; a periodic ext4 reference run keeps the fidelity gap observable.
decisions.action_taken: terms recorded in the CAPA successor on ML-CAPA-364 and in the continuation; no run started
